They sold me a Metashot Cricket Bat Tv Videogame worth Rs.6000 by giving zero information. They themselves didn’t had any knowledge of the bat that they sold. Now how will the child have special personal mobile everytime he play. So we requested to take that game back as this information was not provided to us. Also due to mobile mirroring, there is a timing difference happening everytime. Due to mirroring, whenever u hit a shot, it is hit late and we miss the shot. So the child lost all the interest in the game. The game is not solving its purpose only of playing cricket. Because 90% shot we miss due to mirroring. I raised the concern to the shop but did not get the satisfactory response. Argued for 2 days n they deducted Rs. 1000 without my fault anywhere in this. Totally unsatisfied with this.
